existing_group_assignments.rationale: Inhibition of mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation describes the same decreased beta-oxidation process, with a mitochondrial qualifier.
Increase in luteinizing hormone is the same event as increased LH.
Triglyceride accumulation is closely related to increased triglyceride and triglyceride formation.
Increased liver fibrosis is the same organ-level process as liver fibrosis, in a different organ context from pulmonary fibrosis.

new_groups.rationale: Both describe increased de novo fatty acid synthesis.
Organ-level liver fibrosis versus the cellular collagen accumulation process that contributes to it.
